architecture.summary: Probe tooling only: script/spike/render-tenant-lifecycle.ts and its helper modules under script/spike/render-tenant-lifecycle/ probe the Render private service lifecycle through the Render REST API (create, internal address, image deploy, plan change and back, suspend and resume, delete), with a dry-run mode, a reads-only preflight, and a client guard that touches only the thermus-spike-* service of the run and never the production service; knip lists the script as an entry point. The Slice 1 evidence record docs/implementation/self-onboarding-s1.md gains the section SO-01c: Render private service lifecycle, and the Slice 1 preamble of docs/implementation/self-onboarding-plan.md records the owner decision that Render probes run in the Thermus AI workspace. No source, runtime, registry view, declaration, or deployment change.
